capability: Bind every CI job to one immutable event source while retaining exact-base integration safety
searchEvidence: Formal PR 401 checked out GitHub's synthetic merge ref 7c481e6c even though capability records and release promotion bind exact PR head a2add540; local exact-head verification passed while CI history audit failed.

All five existing actions/checkout steps omit ref in both the executable CI workflow and its canonical template, so every producer, validator, shard, and finalizer inherits the synthetic pull-request checkout.

The release workflow queries required github-actions check runs against the exact reviewed PR head, and repository capability evidence intentionally rejects mutation through an unreviewed merge identity.
semanticOwner: CI event source identity and protected release check-run evidence
terminalContract: For pull_request, every CI producer, validator, and finalizer checks out immutable github.event.pull_request.head.sha; for push, every job checks out immutable github.sha. The required structure gate also proves the exact event base SHA is an ancestor of that head, so head-only verification cannot admit stale integration. Read-only permissions, non-persisted credentials, full history, one evidence SHA, protected-main revalidation, repository validation, release policy, and immutable-record semantics remain unchanged

designReview.evidence: Independent bounded R3 review approved replacing GitHub's synthetic pull-request merge checkout with one explicit immutable source identity across all five jobs in the governed executable CI workflow and its reviewed ungoverned template projection after requiring an exact-base ancestry gate. Pull requests bind to github.event.pull_request.head.sha, pushes bind to github.sha, and the required exact-base gate prevents a stale head from replacing merge-integration coverage. Permissions, action pins, full history, artifact source identity, repository validation, release/promotion policy, firmware behavior, and package semantics remain unchanged; workflow regressions and protected PR/main runs must prove the exact identities before finalization.
